run_sift1M_benchmark: run the sift1M benchmark with IVF Flat indexes across nlist values 8 to 14
run_bigann_benchmark: run the bigann benchmark at multiple scales from 1M to 50M with IVF and IVF HNSW indexes
run_ssnpp_benchmark: run the ssnpp benchmark with IVF PQ, IVF Flat, PQ, and HNSW index variants
run_cli_experiment: run a named experiment like sift1M or bigann by passing experiment name and data path as CLI args
review_benchmark_functions: review the sift1M, bigann, and ssnpp functions to understand index descriptor configurations and benchmark parameters
